description: Unit tests for HttpAuthHandlerBasic, testing authentication token generation, challenge handling, and initialization from challenge strings.

methods.name: GenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Tests the generation of Basic authentication tokens with various username and password combinations.

methods.name: HandleAnotherChallenge
methods.description: Tests handling of different challenge strings and expected authorization results.

methods.name: InitFromChallenge
methods.description: Tests initialization of the auth handler from various challenge strings, including realm parsing and error conditions.

methods.name: BasicAuthRequiresHTTPS
methods.description: Tests that Basic authentication over HTTP is rejected when disabled and allowed over HTTPS.
